shots.detail_en: CH stands in the dawn streets below Lianhua Tower, watching a crane hoist a giant red cloth up toward the exchange's huge announcement board.
CH's gaze sweeps up the tower facade as workers haul the ropes tight, the red cloth swallowing the whole board and bellying in the wind.
CH watches the crowd pool beneath the tower as Retail Investor A points up at the covered board.
shots.sub: 盖这么块大红布——里头怕不是藏着金子？
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG squeezes into the crowd with a steamed bun in hand, sesame on his lip, grinning ear to ear.
shots.sub: 管它里头是啥——红布一升，我的钱包已经全仓躺平了！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED lifts her ledger to her right eye like a monocle behind the old hall counter, pricing the cloth down to the dime.
shots.sub: 这匹红布三丈六，连人工带吊车——比一条假消息还贵。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH reads his buzzing pager — Lianhua group, 9 AM tomorrow, the red cloth falls — and his jaw sets hard.
shots.sub: 传得这么齐——这不是消息，是有人提前画好的一根涨停板。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG freezes mid-bite as every pager on the street buzzes in the same second, pedestrians, vendors and drivers all lifting identical little black boxes.
MANCANG gawks as Retail Investor A and Retail Investor B pull out identical pagers in perfect mirror sync, faces lit by the same three characters.
MANCANG throws his head back laughing, bun crumbs flying into the morning light.
shots.sub: 听见没？全城的BP机都在喊我——满、仓！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH stares up at the red-covered board, brow knotted against the festive roar around him.
shots.sub: 一块红布，吊起全城的胃口——庄家最会画这种大阳线。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH pushes through the noon crowd outside a packed cha chaan teng, the queue spilling onto the street while a wall of TV glow pours through the window.
CH squeezes inside as the camera pans across a wall of boxy CRT TVs, every screen stuttering Lianhua tickers over customers packed like sardines.
MANCANG's father sits nose-to-screen in his cramped flat, tea gone cold, eyes shining at a rerun of XIONG's legendary decade-old forecast.
MANCANG's father leans closer as TV static flashes and XIONG's old interview freezes on a half-smile, the creed replaying through the room.
shots.sub: 市场从不骗人——骗人的，是人的贪心。
shots.speaker: 熊天成（电视）

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's father murmurs at the screen like a prayer, one hand pressed flat over his chest.
shots.sub: 股神十年没说错过……钱我早备好了——红布一揭，养老钱全押。
shots.speaker: 满仓爹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's father pulls a tin from under the bed and smooths a worn bankbook flat, its red-paper label reading 'retirement'.
CH stops in the orange dusk as the red cloth bellies out like a sail against the sky, an entire street craning up in held breath.
RED snaps her ledger shut before close and breathes one long line off her tea, eyes still running numbers.
shots.sub: 全城的赌注都往一块布里钻——今晚有人睡不着，明早有人哭着结账。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: MANCANG crouches at the hall doorway like a sprinter in the blocks, bouncing on his toes.
shots.sub: 明早九点，我第一个冲进场——我叫满仓，这是命！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH stands on the hall's threshold, the VIP box dark above him, and speaks low to the empty floor.
shots.sub: 红布遮住的从来不是消息——是别人的出货单。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH watches from the doorway as night spotlights snap on one by one, the red cloth glowing like blood above a sea of pager-lit faces.
CH's low voice drifts across a black screen as bold white characters bloom: 'Tomorrow 9 AM — the red cloth falls.'
shots.sub: 红布一揭——是开场，还是收场？
shots.speaker: 长虹（画外）
shots.card: 明晨九点·红布揭晓|下集《上过电视的人》
